baselineComparison.description: Retained native global RGB/extinction and old contracting density, with the old eight-lobe mask averaged over angle; legacy angular detail and PNG quantization omitted. Same six-metre framing and same display for old/new. This comparison isolates uniform source chromaticity, not a screenshot reproduction.

uniformInputCheck.description: Identical temperature-retention/loading bases and zero chemical source, then an axial temperature-retention variation only; no color ramp or per-channel mask.

qualification: Numerical SI source/field and CPU ray transfer only; image backgrounds and simple display operator are controlled diagnostics, not the app or camera reproduction.
No measured F135 particle loading, static temperature field, excited-species population or radiation efficiency calibration.
No hardware, airframe, ground, reflection or scattering appears in these field-only images. Geometry/depth acceptance is separate.
